title: Percentages: Increase, Decrease and Profit
seo_title: Percentages – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find percentage increase and decrease; use multipliers; find the original amount; solve problems on profit and loss per cent. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on percentages: multipliers, percentage increase and decrease, reverse percentages and profit and loss per cent in naira. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • To increase by 15%, multiply by 1.15. To decrease by 15%, multiply by 0.85.
  • Percentage change = change ÷ original amount × 100.
  • To find the original amount, divide by the multiplier: after a 20% increase the price is ₦6,000, so the original price is ₦6,000 ÷ 1.2 = ₦5,000.

Examples

Example

₦12,000 decreased by 25%

× 0.75

Answer: ₦9,000

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Dividing by the new amountDivide by the original.
Taking 20% off the new price to go backDivide by 1.2 instead.
Writing 5% as × 1.55% increase is × 1.05.
